goal: Provide usable fee rate estimates instead of errors when the mempool estimator is unready
Avoid broadcasting underpriced transactions when a node restarts without saved mempool data
agreement: Broad support for fallback logic, but contested on whether starved mempools should floor
Contested objection: fallback overestimates fees when mempool is starved (davidgumberg)
Support for falling back to block policy as the cleanest backport option (stickies-v)
Verified that fallback fixes estimation failures seen by downstream wallets (instagibbs, tankyleo)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because missing mempool history currently causes estimators to return minimum fee floors
Prevents wallets and second-layer protocols from broadcasting stuck transactions
